# PBS (Public Broadcasting Service)

> > PBS is America's premier public television network offering free access to documentaries, news analysis, dramas, and educational content across history, science, arts, and culture.

PBS provides a comprehensive streaming platform featuring award-winning documentaries from filmmakers like Ken Burns and FRONTLINE investigations, along with drama series, educational programming, and trusted news coverage. The site serves as a discovery hub for public television content spanning multiple genres and educational levels.

## Key Topics

- FRONTLINE
- Ken Burns
- documentaries
- PBS NewsHour
- Finding Your Roots
- Henry Louis Gates Jr.
- MASTERPIECE
- American history
- public television
- streaming content
- educational programming
- news and public affairs
- independent films
- historical documentaries
- video streaming

## Content Hubs & Explore Sections

- [PBS Homepage](https://www.pbs.org): PBS homepage featuring full episodes, news analysis, documentaries on history, science, and art.
- [History Documentaries](https://www.pbs.org/explore/history): PBS history documentaries covering American history, Civil Rights, and world history.
- [News and Public Affairs](https://www.pbs.org/explore/news-and-public-affairs): PBS news hub with PBS NewsHour, FRONTLINE, and Washington Week coverage.
- [Documentaries and Indie Films](https://www.pbs.org/explore/documentaries-and-indie-films): PBS documentaries and indie films hub featuring FRONTLINE, Ken Burns, and Independent Lens.
- [Science and Nature](https://www.pbs.org/explore/science-and-nature): PBS science and nature documentaries featuring PBS Space Time and educational content.
- [Drama Series](https://www.pbs.org/explore/drama): PBS drama content hub featuring MASTERPIECE series and international drama shows.
- [Arts and Music](https://www.pbs.org/explore/arts): PBS arts and music content hub showcasing live performances, documentaries, and artist biographies.
- [Culture and Travel](https://www.pbs.org/explore/culture): PBS culture and travel exploration hub featuring shows from Henry Louis Gates Jr. and Spike Lee.

## Featured Creators & Programs

- [Henry Louis Gates Jr. Documentaries](https://www.pbs.org/explore/henry-louis-gates-jr): Henry Louis Gates Jr. documentaries including Finding Your Roots and The Black Church.
- [America at 250](https://www.pbs.org/explore/pbs-america-at-250): America's 250th anniversary celebration featuring Ken Burns documentaries and American history.

## Lifestyle & Educational Content

- [Food and Cooking Shows](https://www.pbs.org/explore/food): PBS food and cooking shows hub featuring culinary content, recipes, and chef profiles.
- [Home and How-To](https://www.pbs.org/explore/home-and-how-to): PBS DIY and home improvement content featuring gardening, crafting, and Antiques Roadshow.

## Featured Videos

- [FRONTLINE: Remaking the Middle East](https://www.pbs.org/video/remaking-the-middle-east-the-us-israel-iran): FRONTLINE documentary examining Israel's conflicts in Gaza and Iran with U.S. role.

## Optional

- [Online Sponsorship Support](https://pbs.org/online-sponsorship-support): PBS sponsorship and funding support page with FAQ and advertising disclosure.
